France Excellence Charpak Master's Program 2026 is an opportunity offered by Campus France, India (a government agency that operates under the French Ministry of External Affairs and the Ministry of Higher Education and Research), to Indian students who are currently enrolled in or have studied at an Indian Institution of higher learning. The selected candidates will receive a monthly living allowance of €860 (approx. ₹77,389) and other benefits.
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
be an Indian national or an OCI card holder
be a maximum of 30 years old at the time of application
be currently enrolled in or have studied at an Indian Institution of higher learning
have applied for admission at a French institution, before applying for the scholarship
demonstrate a basic understanding of the French language (not mandatory)
Applicants working on their Master's thesis, training programs, or research projects are not eligible for this program.
Student visa and Etudes en France fee waiver
Assistance to find affordable student accommodation (priority access to CROUS residencies, subject to availability)
Meal discount at university restaurants with meals at €1
Access to social and cultural activities organised by Campus France
Document of employment/internship record, if applicable
Copy of the first page of the passport (with photo and expiry date) [Note: If the applicant will be receiving their passport after the deadline, please attach proof of the passport application.]
Copy of mark sheets and degree of Higher Secondary School (Class 12), Bachelor's, and Master's degrees (including those of completed semesters of the ongoing degree)
Letter(s) of recommendation from the current Indian university/employer or the institution last attended

The letter(s) of recommendation should be submitted as scanned copies of the original typed and signed paper letters. They should preferably pertain to the scholarship and include the referee's signature and contact details. If possible, they should be on the institution's letterhead and bear its stamp.
All documents must be in PDF or JPEG format (Word, RTF, ODT, TXT, MSG documents, ZIP folders, screenshots, or scans of social media are NOT acceptable).
Applications submitted without the required documents or with incorrect documents will be rejected.

The selection will be made based on their academic excellence, as well as the consistency and quality of the statement of purpose.
There is no CGPA/percentage cut-off for the scholarship.
No reason will be given for the rejection of an application.
The French Embassy is not obliged to respond to candidates whose applications are incomplete or not considered for the scholarship award.
Question: Who is eligible for the Charpak Master's Scholarship?
Indian citizens or Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) cardholders below 30 years of age are eligible to apply for this scheme.
Question: How do I apply for the Charpak Master's Scholarship?
Applications are submitted online through the official Campus France India website.
Question: Can I apply for the scholarship if I am already studying in France?
Yes, students already pursuing a master's in France may apply for funding for their second year.
